source: honeyeater-frequer 903dcc88704e (full): production jieba-zh backend through nlp.sentence_stage.analyse_sentence with honeyeater_lemma_zh 1.6.4 (fallback backend, units on)
pos_tagger: honeyeater_lemma_zh 1.6.4 UPOS on every token, as the sentence stage assigns it (per-lemma majority; a multi-token unit is X)
overrides: none applied to lemmas (a release language keeps only the desk's database rows, not available offline); reference/lemma-overrides/zh.json sha256:absent feeds the backend fallback only

units.counted: a compound replaces its member words (a compound is a word); a phrase or construction counts next to its member words
units.entry_field: unit (compound, phrase, construction) on multi-token unit entries

junk.routing: 2+ flags dropped; 1 flag within review_top reviewed (corpora/review/<code>.tsv); proper nouns capitalised in >= propn_drop of running text dropped alone; accent merges applied to the counts

learnable_names.rule: every learnable name gets an entry (developer, 2026-11-02; frequer/names.py)
